requiredOrder: lstat the literal current link path and verify its full signed symlink tuple without calling assert_file on it
readlink/realpath the current link and require the resolved target to equal the signed active release path
construct the expected binary as resolvedTarget + '/ynx-finance'

canonicalCurrentVerifierContract.safety: This relaxes only the invalid canonical-input equality check. Symlink tuple, exact target, binary canonical path, tuple, bytes and SHA remain mandatory.

parents: lease parent directChildren=0 and empty inventory

requiredReceipts.terminal: One normalized non-secret receipt includes all absences, parents, canonical current chain, runtime, service, six HTTP gates, remote exit status and mutationCount=0.
